title: Referenzkorpus Mittelniederdeutsch/Niederrheinisch, 1200-1650 (ReN)
notes: The ReN collection is NOT a ReFrame sub-project but the Referenzkorpus Mittelniederdeutsch/Niederrheinisch (ReN, 1200-1650), the DFG reference corpus of Middle Low German/Low Rhenish texts built at the Universities of Hamburg and Münster. The harvested files ('ReN Low German Agneta_Willeken.xml (1535)', 'ReN Low German Lüb._Bibel_1494.xml (1494)') come from the CorA-ReN-XML TEI dump the project distributes (the RQ snapshot used a local CorA-ReN-XML_1.1 dump); corpus metadata is CC-BY via the RefCorG/REDE framework. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the RQ Open Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, deduplicated texts).
institution: Universität Hamburg (DFG project; Prof. Ingrid Schröder / Prof. Robert Langhanke)
